Table 5. Instrument Driver Error Codes

Status                              Description                            Set By
   0
        No error: the call was successful
-1200
-1201   Invalid syntax string                        VISA Transition Library
-1202
        Error finding instruments                    VISA Transition Library
-1205
-1210   Unable to initialize interface or            VISA Transition Library
-1215   instrument
-1218
-1219   Invalid Instrument Handle                    VISA Transition Library
-1223   Parameter out of range                       Instrument Driver VI
-1224
-1225   Error closing instrument                     VISA Transition Library
-1226
-1230   Error getting attribute                      VISA Transition Library
-1231
-1236   Error setting attribute                      VISA Transition Library
-1240   Instrument identification query failed       Instrument Driver Initialize VI
-1250   Error clearing instrument                    VISA Transition Library
-1251
-1252   Error triggering instrument                  VISA Transition Library
-1260
-1300   Error polling instrument                     VISA Transition Library
-13xx   Error writing to instrument                  VISA Transition Library

        Error reading from instrument                VISA Transition Library

        Error interpreting instrument response       Instrument Driver VI

        Instrument timed out                         VISA Transition Library
        Error mapping VXI address                    VISA Transition Library
        Error unmapping VXI address                  VISA Transition Library

        Error accessing VXI address                  VISA Transition Library

        Function not supported by controller         VISA Transition Library
        Instrument-specific error
